summary: Selects additional image streams from a primary active Kinect Azure TOP.
common_gotchas: No useful output appears without an active primary Kinect Azure TOP.
Aligned-stream resolution depends on the primary Color Resolution or Depth Mode.
Player index depends on body tracking and may need additional hardware support.
Remapped point clouds can contain gaps and artifacts.
key_concepts: Kinect Azure Select TOP captures additional streams from a primary Kinect Azure TOP.
The referenced primary TOP must be active and owns camera configuration.
Select TOP inherits camera resolution, frame rate, depth, sync, and tracking setup from the primary.
Image modes include color, remapped color, depth, remapped depth, infrared, player index, and point clouds.
Point cloud stores XYZ coordinates in RGB channels in meters.
This operator is for extra streams, not for configuring a physical camera.
